newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SingTel says 1 mln apply for 2nd offer.
newsitem.headline: SingTel says 1 mln apply for 2nd offer.

text.p: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) said on Thursday it so far had received over one million applications for a total of more than 500 million shares in its second offer to the public.
A company statement said 97 percent of applicants asked for their maximum entitlements and to date, 900,000 have been allocated their shares.
Singapore announced in August the telecommunications giant would offer a second tranche of more than one billion shares to the public. A similar offering of shares was made in 1993.
